svg.title: Baghdad braced body and powered bogie frame stock
svg.text: Revision B / Body and two bogie frames / Vehicle coordinates in metres
Four 1.30 m clear openings per side. Ten braces occupy the closed bays between and beyond the doors.
Two side rails, two transoms, two spring saddles.
Orange pads locate four primary and two secondary seats.
Wheelsets, drives, brakes and suspension await integration.
Orthographic views of nominal steel pieces. Connections, fitted equipment and skin require separate geometry.
